```{r}

X <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
Y <- c(2, 4, 5, 4, 5)
n <- length(X)

cat("Dataset loaded successfully.\n")
```

```{r}

m <- 0.0
c_intercept <- 0.0

learning_rate <- 0.01
epochs <- 1000

cat(sprintf("Initial guesses -> m: %.1f, c: %.1f\n", m, c_intercept))
cat(sprintf("Learning Rate: %.2f, Epochs: %d\n", learning_rate, epochs))
```

```{r}

for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
  dm <- 0.0
  dc <- 0.0
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    y_pred <- m * X[i] + c_intercept
    error <- y_pred - Y[i]
    
    dm <- dm + (2 / n) * error * X[i]
    dc <- dc + (2 / n) * error
  }
  

  m <- m - learning_rate * dm
  c_intercept <- c_intercept - learning_rate * dc
}
cat("--- Optimization Complete ---\n")
cat(sprintf("Optimized Slope (m): %.4f\n", m))
cat(sprintf("Optimized Intercept (c): %.4f\n", c_intercept))
```
```{r}

predictions <- m * X + c_intercept

cat("Actual Y:   ", paste(Y, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Predicted Y:", paste(round(predictions, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")

mse <- sum((Y - predictions)^2) / n
cat(sprintf("Mean Squared Error (MSE): %.4f\n", mse))
```

```{r}

plot(X, Y, col = "blue", pch = 16, cex = 2,
     xlab = "X (Independent Variable)",
     ylab = "Y (Dependent Variable)",
     main = "Simple Linear Regression via Gradient Descent",
     xlim = c(0.5, 5.5), ylim = c(1, 6))


grid(nx = NULL, ny = NULL, col = "lightgray", lty = "dotted")

abline(a = c_intercept, b = m, col = "red", lwd = 2)


legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Actual Data Points", sprintf("Regression Line: y = %.2fx + %.2f", m, c_intercept)),
       col = c("blue", "red"), pch = c(16, NA), lty = c(NA, 1), lwd = c(NA, 2))
```
